gaps.summary: Figma tokens fail WCAG AA 4.5:1 in places and AppTheme follows them as the source of truth. color/on-primary (#fdfdfd) on color/primary: 2.5:1 in Dark, True-dark and Slate, 2.4:1 in Dracula, 4.0:1 in Light. On color/danger: 3.1:1 Dracula, 3.7:1 Slate, 3.9:1 Light, 4.1:1 Dark and True-dark. color/text-secondary on color/app-background: 4.3:1 Light, 3.6:1 True-dark, 3.0:1 Dracula (Dark and Slate pass). color/text-muted: 2.5:1 Light, 3.0:1 True-dark, 4.0:1 Dracula, 4.4:1 Dark and Slate. Needs a Figma decision; PRODUCT.md has no WCAG target yet. color/border as the only outline of a control (App/Molecule/Seletor segmentado border and divider) is 1.2-1.6:1 against color/app-background, below the 3:1 non-text guideline; the labels and the check icon carry the state. color/primary and color/danger as text on color/context-menu-bg (App/Organism/Diálogo/Confirmação actions) in Light: 3.8:1 and 3.7:1; the other themes pass. Download states drawn with raw tokens on the chapter card (color/secondary-60 over color/app-background), below 4.5:1: color/warning 1.3:1 in Light; color/success 2.5:1 in Light and 3.1:1 in Dark and True-dark; color/danger 3.2:1 in Light, 3.5:1 in Dracula and 4.4:1 in Slate; color/text-secondary 2.3:1 in Dracula, 3.8:1 in True-dark and 4.1:1 in Light. Issue #93 colours these icons and status texts with theme.legible(), which reaches at least 5.4:1 on the card in every theme. color/primary as the download summary's action text on the card: 3.2:1 in Light. color/danger as delete-action labels on color/context-menu-bg in Light: 3.9:1 for the selection bar and as drawn over the page, about 3.5:1 for sheets over the modal barrier in code, 3.7:1 for the dialog over the scrim. In Dark, True-dark and Slate the dialog panel is nearly the colour of the scrimmed background, so only the color/text-10 border (1.2-1.4:1) outlines it. Lilac pairings (snackbar, tertiary) use color/on-lilac (#000212, AppPalette.onLilac in code), 6.4:1 on color/lilac. Components from issue #126 (all measured by computing the pairs from the variable values): the Core/Molecule/Interruptor/Item knob in color/on-primary on the color/primary track is 2.5:1 in Dark, True-dark and Slate, 2.4:1 in Dracula and 4.0:1 in Light (non-text guideline is 3:1); the off track color/border against color/app-background is 1.2-1.6:1 and the off knob color/text-secondary on that track is 1.9:1 in Dracula (3.7-4.6:1 elsewhere); App/Atom/Esqueleto color/text-10 against the background is 1.2-1.35:1 (decorative placeholder, no text); the App/Molecule/Cartão de chamada note in color/text-secondary on the card is 2.3:1 in Dracula, 3.8:1 in True-dark and 4.1:1 in Light (Dark and Slate pass), and the card title and description in color/text pass in every theme (10.3:1 or more); the App/Molecule/Cartão de chamada and App/Molecule/Vista de erro primary buttons repeat the color/on-primary on color/primary pairs above; the App/Organism/Diálogo/Confiar em certificado action color/primary on the color/context-menu-bg panel over color/app-background is 4.0:1 in Light (the 3.8:1 above for App/Organism/Diálogo/Confirmação is measured over the scrim, where the panel is darker). Logo from issue #144 (measured from the variable values; the logo is fixed brand art, so its colors do not change with the theme): the `#000212` body of `Core/Atom/Marca/Logo` is 1.0-1.4:1 against color/app-background in Dark, True-dark, Dracula and Slate, so the dark shapes disappear into the page there and only the orange parts read (17.8:1 in Light, where the shapes show); `#f18522` is 2.2:1 on color/app-background in Light (5.5-8.1:1 in the other themes). Both are brand decisions for Figma, not fixed here. App lock frames (issue #127, computed from the variable values against color/app-background): color/primary as the grace-period section header and as the selected `App/Molecule/Rádio/Item` ring and dot is 8.0:1 in Dark, 8.1:1 in True-dark, 7.0:1 in Slate, 5.9:1 in Dracula and 3.5:1 in Light (the text is below 4.5:1 in Light; the 3:1 non-text guideline holds); color/danger as the lock cover error text is 4.9:1 in Dark, 5.0:1 in True-dark, 4.8:1 in Slate, 4.5:1 in Dracula and 3.4:1 in Light; color/text-secondary as the cancelled message and as the unselected `App/Molecule/Rádio/Item` ring is 7.1:1 in Slate, 5.0:1 in Dark, 4.3:1 in Light, 3.6:1 in True-dark and 3.0:1 in Dracula (the ring just meets 3:1 in Dracula); the `Core/Molecule/Interruptor/Item` rows repeat the knob and track pairs above; the authenticating button repeats color/on-primary on color/primary at 60% opacity. MFA frames (issue #128, computed from the variable values): color/danger as the error message and the Desativar label on color/app-background is 4.9:1 Dark, 5.0:1 True-dark, 4.8:1 Slate, 4.5:1 Dracula and 3.5:1 Light; the App/Atom/Caixa de seleção unmarked outline (color/text-secondary, non-text guideline 3:1) is 5.0:1 Dark, 7.1:1 Slate, 4.2:1 Light, 3.6:1 True-dark and 3.0:1 Dracula; the marked box repeats the color/on-primary on color/primary pairs above and color/primary against the background is 3.5:1 in Light and 5.9-8.1:1 elsewhere. Components from issue #129 (computed from the variable values, card = color/secondary-60 over color/app-background): the status Core/Atom/Tag label in color/warning, color/success or color/danger on its -15 tint over the card is 8.6:1, 2.8:1 and 4.1:1 in Dark, 1.2:1, 2.2:1 and 2.5:1 in Light, 8.7:1, 2.8:1 and 4.1:1 in True-dark, 4.7:1, 5.6:1 and 3.0:1 in Dracula, 5.9:1, 5.2:1 and 3.8:1 in Slate; the request URL in color/primary on the card is 3.2:1 in Light and 4.6:1 in Dracula (6.4:1 or more in Dark, True-dark and Slate); the rejection message in color/danger on the card is 3.2:1 in Light, 3.5:1 in Dracula and 4.4:1 in Slate (4.52:1 in Dark, 4.6:1 in True-dark); the date line in color/text-muted on the card is 2.5:1 in Light, 3.1:1 in True-dark, 3.5:1 in Dracula, 4.3:1 in Slate and 4.48:1 in Dark; the disabled submit button on /requests/create is 38% opacity, so its label is below 3:1 by design. Code colors the badge text with theme.legible, which targets 4.5:1 (not measured on the badge tint here); Figma's raw tokens do not. Components and frames from issue #62 (pairs computed from the variable values): the fingerprint line and empty message in color/border on color/app-background are 1.2-1.6:1 (1.33:1 in Dark; code uses colorScheme.outline); the error snackbar text color/on-lilac on color/danger is 4.9:1 in Dark and True-dark, 5.2:1 in Light, 5.5:1 in Slate and 6.6:1 in Dracula; the color/danger error line on the welcome field is 3.5:1 in Light and 4.5:1 in Dracula (others 4.8-5.0:1); the App/Atom/Botão de ação flutuante glyph repeats the color/on-primary on color/primary pairs above (non-text guideline 3:1); the App/Molecule/Abas selected label in color/primary on color/app-background is 3.5:1 in Light (8.0:1 in Dark), and the unselected label in color/text-secondary repeats the 3.0-4.3:1 cases above; the disabled Selecionar Arquivo PEM (color/primary at 38% on color/context-menu-bg) is about 1.9:1 in Dark (1.7-2.1:1 across themes); the welcome spinner in color/primary on the disabled button fill (color/text-10 over color/app-background) is 6.8:1 in Dark, 4.4:1 in Dracula and 2.9:1 in Light.

The #126 components are drawn in the intended Figma look, so code differs and each item is a code follow-up. Core/Molecule/Interruptor/Item: one row with an optional icon replaces AppSwitch (plain SwitchListTile, used in Settings and App lock), AppSwitchRow and ReaderSwitchRow. App/Atom/Esqueleto: code fills with onSurfaceVariant at 30% alpha (AppSkeleton, AppTextSkeleton), Figma uses color/text-10; the two skeleton widgets merge. App/Atom/Indicador de carregamento: code defaults to the Material indeterminate indicator with strokeWidth 2 and takes the size from the caller (20 in AppButton, 24 in the load-more footer, 40 in the profile page, none elsewhere); Figma names the 20/24/40 dp sizes as variants. App/Molecule/Vista de erro: code builds a raw ElevatedButton and TextButton with a message in the default text style; Figma uses the `Core/Atom/Botão` Variant=Primary and Text and Corpo/Padrão text (AppButton and AppTextButton in code). App/Molecule/Cartão de chamada: code is a Material Card with elevation 2, a bold titleLarge title, a bodySmall note in onSurface instead of color/text-secondary, a 20 dp gap before the button instead of space/sm, and a FilledButton.icon; Figma is a flat card with a color/border outline, Título/3 and the `Core/Atom/Botão` Variant=Primary. App/Organism/Diálogo/Confiar em certificado: code uses an AlertDialog with a raw TextField and an ElevatedButton for Confiar; Figma uses the App/Organism/Diálogo/Confirmação shape, App/Atom/Campo/Texto and text buttons. The disabled card button has no Figma treatment beyond 38% opacity. MFA screens (issue #128): mfa_settings_screen.dart builds raw OutlinedButton (with icons), TextButton, CheckboxListTile and AlertDialog; Figma uses `Core/Atom/Botão` Variant=Outline and Text (AppOutlinedButton of #101, AppTextButton), App/Atom/Caixa de seleção (new AppCheckbox atom) and App/Organism/Diálogo/Confirmação, with the disable dialog's code field between message and actions (the `Show field` property of App/Organism/Diálogo/Confirmação, #265). The MFA code field has a leading shield icon that App/Atom/Campo/Texto lacks (an icon slot on AppTextField/App/Atom/Campo/Texto), the secret and backup codes use a monospace titleMedium with no Figma text style, the settings loading phase builds a raw CircularProgressIndicator where Figma uses App/Atom/Indicador de carregamento (AppLoadingIndicator), and both screens build a Material AppBar (until #251). Outlined-button icons (copy, open_in_new, share) cannot be swapped on the Figma instances.

The welcome and certificates frames (issue #62) show the code as it is today, except that `App/Molecule/Abas`, `App/Atom/Botão de ação flutuante` and `App/Molecule/Certificado/Item` give the Material `TabBar`, `FloatingActionButton` and `ListTile` token-bound colors that code takes from Material defaults (unselected tab `onSurfaceVariant`, FAB `primaryContainer`); the row subject is `bodySmall` in `onSurface` (`color/text`), drawn `color/text-secondary`. Welcome: code draws `Icons.pets` instead of `Core/Atom/Marca/Logo`, uses a raw `TextField`, `ElevatedButton` and 36 dp `CircularProgressIndicator` instead of `App/Atom/Campo/Texto`, `Core/Atom/Botão` and the 24 dp `App/Atom/Indicador de carregamento`, and `WelcomeViewModel` hard-codes its three messages in English instead of ARB keys. Certificates: the add dialog is a raw `AlertDialog` with a raw `TextField` and `ElevatedButton`, and the delete confirmation is a raw `AlertDialog` that should use `AppConfirmDialog` (#147); the error snackbar is `colorScheme.error` while the theme snackbar is lilac, the row title uses the undefined `titleMedium` (Figma `Corpo/Padrão`), the empty message is italic (no Figma italic style) and the tab bar and FAB are not extracted, while the row molecule builds a raw `ListTile`, `IconButton` and delete `AlertDialog` instead of using atoms. Each item is a code follow-up.

The app lock frames (issue #127, section `1052:38698` of page 04) draw what the code does, so these are the differences and each is a code follow-up. The switch rows are `AppSwitch` (plain `SwitchListTile`), drawn as `Core/Molecule/Interruptor/Item` Icon=No. The grace-period choices are Material `RadioListTile`s in the theme's default colours, drawn as `App/Molecule/Rádio/Item` (`color/primary` selected, `color/text-secondary` otherwise); code has no shared radio atom. `SettingsSectionHeader` is `titleMedium` bold in `color/primary` (16 dp); no text style matches, so the frames use `Interface/Botão` (14 dp SemiBold) in `color/primary`. The lock cover builds its title, description and error as inline `Text` (`headlineSmall`, `bodyMedium`, error in `color/danger`, or `color/text-secondary` after a cancel) and an `AppButton`; the authenticating frame shows `Core/Atom/Botão` Primary at 60% opacity with `Core/Atom/Ícone/loader` and no label, where code shows `AppLoadingIndicator` (20 dp, `color/on-primary`) in a disabled button. The cover uses the logo at 96 dp. The entry row in `/settings` uses `App/Molecule/Lista/Item` with `Core/Atom/Ícone/lock` (added in #127, Lucide style) where code uses `Icons.lock_outline`, and its description is cut to one line in Figma while the `ListTile` subtitle wraps. The Figma frames omit the SnackBar's behaviour (hidden before the next one) and the `Semantics` live regions on the cover and the unsupported text.

Material text roles Figma does not define (displayMedium, displaySmall, headlineLarge, titleMedium, titleSmall) keep Material default sizes but render in Inknut Antiqua through ThemeData.fontFamily; bodySmall and other roles use onSurface, not color/text-secondary or color/text-muted. The mapped roles also change Material default sizes globally (bodyLarge 16->18, bodyMedium 14->16, bodySmall 12->14, labelMedium 12->13, labelSmall 11->12) with 150-160% line heights, so ListTile, TextField, dialog and chip text grow; check fixed-height rows at large text scales.
radius/*, space/* and Vidro effects have no ThemeData/ThemeExtension counterpart.

GatunoColors badge colors (badgeDefault, badgeSearch, badgeType, badgeExcluded, badgeSensitive, badgePublication, badgeAuthor) and the AppColors.badge*Light constants have no Figma variable; the Figma Core/Atom/Tag and Core/Atom/Filtro/* components should be inspected before mapping.
GatunoColors.degrader gradient has no Figma style.

Figma mobile sections 3 (Library/Profile), 4 (Auth) and 5 (Settings) have frames since issue #52 (Dark theme only, key states). Welcome (`/welcome`) and certificates (`/settings/certificates`) have mobile frames since issue #62. Still without frames: web sections 3 (Auth) and 4 (Settings), web /library and /users/:userId, and the code-only routes listed under `routes-differ`. The MFA screens (/auth/mfa, /settings/mfa) have frames since issue #128, in their own sections on the same page (1052:38039, 1052:39164); see .impeccable/surfaces/mfa.md.

Figma routes /library, /users/:userId and /latest-reads have no matching code routes; Figma /auth/login, /auth/register, /user and /users/:userId map to code /auth/signin, /auth/signup, /settings and /settings/profile under different names. Code-only routes without Figma frames: /chapters/:id and /chapters/:id/page/:index.
Collection 'Gatuno / The Cheap Weekly' (press-black palette) is a redesign exploration and is excluded from tokens.

The reader font picker offers Atkinson Hyperlegible and OpenDyslexic (bundled, OFL) as the Figma dropdown lists them, but Figma has no text style for either; only Leitura/Serifa (Literata) and Leitura/Dislexia (Lexend) are styled.

The #129 frames for /requests and /requests/create draw first load, error and empty in the intended look, so code differs and each item is a code follow-up: first load shows App/Atom/Esqueleto cards (code: a CircularProgressIndicator), error uses App/Molecule/Vista de erro (code: an error icon, red text and a raw ElevatedButton.icon), empty uses the App/Molecule/Cartão de chamada look (code: Icons.inbox_outlined, muted text and a raw ElevatedButton.icon). BookRequestCard is a Material Card with elevation 2 and a bold titleLarge title; Figma App/Molecule/Solicitação/Cartão is a flat color/secondary-60 card with a color/border outline and Título/3. AppStatusBadge uses labelSmall bold on a 20% tint with a 50% border; Figma Core/Atom/Tag uses Interface/Rótulo on color/*-15 and color/*-40. The icon library has no info or calendar icon, so the reason row uses Ícone/file-text and the date Ícone/clock where code uses Icons.info_outline and Icons.calendar_today. AppButton and Figma `Core/Atom/Botão` are both 48 dp high. The `/requests` frames draw the native `App/Organism/Shell/Barra superior` and `App/Organism/Shell/Barra inferior` (#170); the `/requests/create` frames draw them as well since #260. The '+' IconButton has no tooltip. Not drawn: pull-to-refresh and the success SnackBar.

The #169 components draw the target shell, so code differs and each item is a code follow-up. `AppBottomNavBar` is 48 dp with icons only (tooltips) and three items; Figma is 80 dp with labels, an indicator pill and an optional badge, and a Biblioteca item (a placeholder screen until #130 ships) in place of Settings (#172). The item differs too: code draws a 28 dp icon in `colorScheme.primary` or `onSurfaceVariant` with no indicator and no label; Figma draws a 24 dp icon in `color/primary` or `color/text-secondary` in a `color/primary-15` pill, with a label. Every shell screen uses the shared `AppTopBar` since #251; Figma's `App/Organism/Shell/Barra superior` is: a single 64 dp row on tab roots and pushed screens alike (title or logo left, actions right, the profile avatar `Core/Atom/Avatar/Perfil` in the last tab-root slot), plus a search row on Livros, which hides and returns on scroll (#266, #251). Home keeps the `/books?...` links and a requests card; Figma adds a row for `/requests` to the merged profile and settings screen, which both Figma and code (#251) open from an avatar action on every tab root. Phone frames (#260): the pushed sub-pages `/settings/download`, `/settings/app-lock`, `/settings/mfa` and `/requests/create` draw the same bars as the other pushed screens (their code lands with #251 and #172), and Home draws the requests card, with a guest and an offline frame (the icon library has no `library_add` or login icon, so the buttons show `Core/Atom/Ícone/plus`). The app lock cover, the auth screens and welcome stay without a shell by design. Figma contrast: the unselected item icon and label in `color/text-secondary` repeat the 3.0-4.3:1 cases of `figma-contrast`; the badge text `color/on-primary` on `color/danger` repeats 3.1-4.1:1; the logo's `#000212` body in the Home bar disappears into the dark themes (see the logo note in `figma-contrast`).

The #171 frames draw the tablet layouts, so code differs and each item is a code follow-up. There are no window size classes or breakpoints in code (the reader in #112 asks for its own), and the shell always shows `AppBottomNavBar`; Figma uses the rail from 600 dp up (#173). The books grid takes a fixed column count (`BookGrid`, `SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount`), not a minimum card width (#252). Book detail is one column (`BookDetailsTemplate`) at every width (#253). Settings is a tab and pushes every sub-page; Figma has no Settings tab and shows the merged profile and settings screen as list-detail on expanded (#254). Home has a carousel of fixed 350 dp height (`FeaturedCarousel`); Figma caps it at 360 dp on tablets and draws a side-by-side panel (#255). `AuthTemplate` caps sign in and sign up at 400 dp and the welcome screen has no cap; Figma uses 480 dp for the three (#256). Bottom sheets already get the 640 dp cap from the Material 3 default (no `bottomSheetTheme`), but the books filters open as a bottom sheet at every width, not as a side sheet on expanded (#252). The rail is 80 dp wide with three destinations (#173). Frames are Dark first with the other four modes checked on a sample; Library and Latest reads frames (references for #130 and #132) are drawn without the routes existing in code.
